attributes.name: Magaav Commander
attributes.powers:
The Magaav Commander is immune to the Fire and Poison traits. 

Before you act, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 15 check or you may not play spells with the Attack trait. 

If the Magaav Commander would be defeated, ignore the result and reroll the dice. The Magaav Commander is defeated or undefeated based solely on the rsult of the second die roll. 

If you would discard cards due to damage from the Magaav Commander, bury them instead.
